verdict.rationale: An operating system could plausibly ship a built-in AI coding agent in its terminal, so this story applies to macOS. The evidence covers Siri AI conversations, drafting help and in-app actions, plus non-AI command-line utilities. Nothing shows an AI agent in the terminal that writes or runs code.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use built-in AI coding agents directly in the terminal to write and run code
